name: BambooHR
description: BambooHR is an HRIS for small and mid-sized businesses covering employee records, hiring/onboarding, time and benefits tracking, performance management, and payroll, with a named in-product assistant (Bamboo AI) and published per-employee pricing tiers.
best_for: Small and mid-sized businesses wanting an HR system of record with hiring, onboarding, and employee-experience tools, plus payroll as an add-on.
features: Centralized employee records with automated reporting and a mobile app
Applicant tracking system (Hiring) with candidate experience and onboarding task tracking
Time tracking, benefits enrollment, and payroll automation (payroll available as an add-on, U.S. only)
Performance management, employee satisfaction surveys, and recognition/awards
Compensation planning and benchmarking data on higher tiers
Compliance training courses (course count varies by plan tier)
Bamboo AI assistant embedded in the platform, with more capability unlocked on higher tiers
150+ pre-built integrations through the BambooHR marketplace
pros: Publishes per-employee pricing across three named tiers instead of requiring a quote for every deal
Flat-rate pricing option available for companies with 25 or fewer employees
Offers a self-serve 7-day free trial rather than requiring a sales demo to try the product
cons: Performance management, employee community, and higher compliance-training-course counts require upgrading to Pro or Elite
Compensation management, custom dashboards, and HR benchmarking are reserved for the top Elite tier

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: For companies over 25 employees; flat rate starting at $250/month for 25 or fewer employees. Includes HR data/reporting, hiring, time off, and a base AI assistant.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds performance management, employee community, recognition/rewards, and 15 compliance training courses.

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.notes: Adds compensation management, custom dashboards/analytics, HR benchmarks, and 300+ compliance training courses.

alternatives.name: Gusto
alternatives.description: A payroll, benefits, and HR platform focused on small and mid-sized U.S. businesses with payroll as a first-class feature rather than an add-on.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses that want payroll included in the core product rather than bolted on.

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: A modular workforce platform unifying HR, payroll, IT device management, and spend management on one employee record.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting to add IT and finance modules alongside HR rather than a dedicated HR-only system.

alternatives.name: Greenhouse
alternatives.description: A dedicated applicant tracking and hiring platform focused on structured, data-driven recruiting.
alternatives.best_for: Companies whose primary need is a best-in-class ATS rather than an all-in-one HRIS with hiring bundled in.
